pages.text: Rest at a lit bonfire to $(l)heal$(), $(l)refill your Estus$() and $(l)set where you wake$().$(br2)You can travel between any bonfires you have rested at. Enemies nearby? No rest.
$(l)Stand beside$() a lit bonfire for five seconds, too. It eases your $(l)afflictions$(), mends your sanity, and lets you $(l)level up$(). Wake beside one after dying and the same is true.
Plant a Coiled Sword in a $(item)Pile of Bone and Ash$() to light a new bonfire. Lost yours? Smith an iron sword with a Coiled Sword Fragment, using a fire charge as the template.
Light bonfires near anywhere you go often: a mine, a boss lair, your base. A $(item)Homeward Bone$() takes you back to the last one you rested at.
